    (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mpr h7
  have hrem : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 0 := by
    simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hmod
  have hrem' : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 6 := by
    have : ((2 ^ n) % 7 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by
      simpa [Nat.add_mod] using hrem
    have hlt : (2 ^ n) % 7 < 7 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
    have hcases :
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = 0 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 2 ∨
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = 3 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 4 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 5 ∨
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = 6 := by
      interval_cases ((2 ^ n) % 7) using hlt
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | h5 | h6
    · have : (0 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h0] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (1 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h1] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (2 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h2] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (3 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h3] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (4 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h4] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (5 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h5] using this
      norm_num at this
    · exact h6
  have hrem'' : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 6 := by
    simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n] using hrem'
  have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
    have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
    interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt
  rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
  · have : (2 ^ 0) % 7 = 6 := by simpa [h0] using hrem''

    norm_num at this

import Mathlib

/-- Helper lemma: 2^n mod 7 depends only on n mod 3 -/
lemma pow_two_mod_7 (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by
  have h_decomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    rw [Nat.div_add_mod]
    <;> ring
  rw [h_decomp]
  rw [pow_add]
  rw [pow_mul]
  -- 2^(3k+r) = (2^3)^k * 2^r
  -- (2^3)^k % 7 = 8^k % 7 = 1^k % 7 = 1
  have h_pow3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have h_pow_base : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
    rw [Nat.pow_mod]
    rw [h_pow3]
    simp [Nat.pow_one, Nat.mod_one]
    <;> norm_num
  have h_mul : (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 
    (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by
    simp [Nat.mul_mod]
  rw [h_mul]
  rw [h_pow_base]
  simp [Nat.mul_one]
  <;> rfl

      rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at h

        intro h_zero
        have : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n := Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h_zero
        have h_prime : Nat.Prime 7 := by decide
        have h_not_dvd : ¬ 7 ∣ 2 ^ n := Nat.Prime.not_dvd_pow h_prime (by decide)
        exact h_not_dvd this
      have h_lt : 2 ^ n % 7 < 7 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
      omega
    have h_sub : (2 ^ n - 1) % 7 = (2 ^ n % 7 - 1) % 7 := by
      rw [← Nat.mod_add_div (2 ^ n) 7]
      simp [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_self]
      <;> omega
    rw [h_sub] at h_dvd
    have h_val : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      omega
    have h_helper : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := pow_two_mod_7 n
    rw [h_helper] at h_val

    rcases h_cases with (h_case | h_case | h_case)

import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModPow
import Mathlib.Tactic

open Nat

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n` modulo `7` depends only on `n mod 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := (Nat.mod_add_div n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * (2 ^ (n % 3))) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this, one_mul]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  constructor
  · intro h7
    -- from divisibility we obtain a congruence
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] :=
      (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mpr h7
    have hrem : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hmod
    have hrem' : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
      simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n] using hrem
    have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
    · exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h0
    · exfalso
      have : (2 ^ 1) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [h1] using hrem'
      norm_num at this
    · exfalso
      have : (2 ^ 2) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [h2] using hrem'
      norm_num at this
  · intro h3
    have hmod3 : n % 3 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h3
    have hrem : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [hmod3] using (by norm_num : (2 ^ 0) % 7 = 1)
      simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n] using this
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by
      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hrem
    exact (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mp hmod

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (b): no positive `n` has `7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1`. -/
theorem p09_b (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬ 7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := by
  intro h7
  have hmod : (2 ^ n + 1) ≡ (0 : ℕ) [MOD 7] :=
    (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mpr h7
  have hrem : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 0 := by
    simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hmod
  have hrem' : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 6 := by
    have : ((2 ^ n) % 7 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by
      simpa [Nat.add_mod] using hrem
    have hlt : (2 ^ n) % 7 < 7 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
    have hcases :
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = 0 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 2 ∨
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = 3 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 4 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 5 ∨
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = 6 := by
      interval_cases ((2 ^ n) % 7) using hlt
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | h5 | h6
    · have : (0 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h0] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (1 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h1] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (2 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h2] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (3 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h3] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (4 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h4] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (5 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h5] using this
      norm_num at this
    · exact h6
  have hrem'' : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 6 := by
    simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n] using hrem'
  have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
    have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
    interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt
  rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
  · have : (2 ^ 0) % 7 = 6 := by simpa [h0] using hrem''
    norm_num at this
  · have : (2 ^ 1) % 7 = 6 := by simpa [h1] using hrem''
    norm_num at this
  · have : (2 ^ 2) % 7 = 6 := by simpa [h2] using hrem''
    norm_num at this

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n` modulo `7` depends only on `n mod 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := (Nat.mod_add_div n 3).symm

    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * (2 ^ (n % 3))) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this

      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)

          simpa [pow_mul]

            simpa [h3] using this

open Nat

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n` modulo `7` depends only on `n mod 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := (Nat.mod_add_div n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * (2 ^ (n % 3))) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this, one_mul]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa

theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by

  · intro h7

      dsimp [Nat.ModEq] at hmod

    have hrem' : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
      simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n] using hrem

      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)

import Mathlib
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModPow
import Mathlib.Tactic

open Nat

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n` modulo `7` depends only on `n mod 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := (Nat.mod_add_div n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * (2 ^ (n % 3))) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this, one_mul]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  constructor
  · intro h7
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] :=
      (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mpr h7
    have hrem : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      dsimp [Nat.ModEq] at hmod
      simpa using hmod
    have hrem' : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
      simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n] using hrem
    have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
    · exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h0
    · exfalso
      have : (2 ^ 1) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [h1] using hrem'
      norm_num at this
    · exfalso
      have : (2 ^ 2) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [h2] using hrem'
      norm_num at this
  · intro h3
    have hmod3 : n % 3 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h3
    have hrem : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa using (by norm_num : (2 ^ 0) % 7 = 1)
      simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n, hmod3] using this
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by
      dsimp [Nat.ModEq]
      simpa [hrem]
    exact (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mp hmod

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (b): no positive `n` has `7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1`. -/
theorem p09_b (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬ 7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := by
  intro h7
  have hmod : (2 ^ n + 1) ≡ (0 : ℕ) [MOD 7] :=
    (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mpr h7
  have hrem : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 0 := by
    dsimp [Nat.ModEq] at hmod
    simpa using hmod
  have hrem' : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 6 := by
    have : ((2 ^ n) % 7 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by
      simpa [Nat.add_mod] using hrem
    have hlt : (2 ^ n) % 7 < 7 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
    have hcases :
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = 0 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 2 ∨
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = 3 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 4 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 5 ∨
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = 6 := by
      interval_cases ((2 ^ n) % 7) using hlt
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | h5 | h6
    · have : (0 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h0] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (1 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h1] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (2 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h2] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (3 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h3] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (4 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h4] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (5 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h5] using this
      norm_num at this
    · exact h6
  have hrem'' : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 6 := by
    simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n] using hrem'
  have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
    have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
    interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt
  rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
  · exfalso
    have : (2 ^ 0) % 7 = 6 := by simpa [h0] using hrem''
    norm_num at this
  · exfalso
    have : (2 ^ 1) % 7 = 6 := by simpa [h1] using hrem''
    norm_num at this
  · exfalso
    have : (2 ^ 2) % 7 = 6 := by simpa [h2] using hrem''

/-- Helper lemma: 2^n mod 7 depends only on n mod 3 -/
lemma pow_two_mod_7 (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by

  rw [pow_add]
  rw [pow_mul]

  -- We want to show this mod 7 is equal to 2^(n%3) mod 7
  -- Since 2^3 = 8 ≡ 1 mod 7

  have h_pow_base : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
    -- Prove (8^k) % 7 = 1
    have h : ∀ k : ℕ, (8 ^ k) % 7 = 1 := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k ih =>
        rw [pow_succ]
        simp [Nat.mul_mod, ih, Nat.mod_mod]
        <;> norm_num
    exact h (n / 3)
  
  calc
    2 ^ n % 7 = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
      rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
      <;> rfl
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by
      simp [Nat.mul_mod]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by rw [h_pow_base]
    _ = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by simp [Nat.mul_one, Nat.mod_mod]

      have h_sub_lt : 2 ^ n % 7 - 1 < 7 := by omega

import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModPow
import Mathlib.Tactic

open Nat

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n` modulo `7` depends only on `n mod 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := (Nat.mod_add_div n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * (2 ^ (n % 3))) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this, one_mul]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  have hiff := (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff (a := 2 ^ n) (b := 1) (n := 7))
  constructor

    have hmod : (2 ^ n) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := (hiff).mpr h7

      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hmod

      simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n] using hrem

      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2

      simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n, hmod3] using (by norm_num : (2 ^ 0) % 7 = 1)

        (2 ^ n) % 7 = 3 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 4 ∨ (2 ^ n) % 7 = 5 ∨

    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | h5 | h6
    · have : (0 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h0] using this
      norm_num at this
    · have : (1 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by simpa [h1] using this
      norm_num at this

import Mathlib

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  constructor
  · -- Forward direction: 7 ∣ 2^n - 1 → 3 ∣ n
    intro h
    have h_mod : (2 ^ n - 1) % 7 = 0 := Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mp h
    have h_ge : 1 ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hn
    have h_sub_mod : (2 ^ n - 1) % 7 = (2 ^ n % 7 - 1) % 7 := by
      rw [Nat.mod_sub_mod h_ge]
    rw [h_sub_mod] at h_mod
    have h_val : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      rw [h_sub_mod] at h_mod
      norm_num at h_mod
      omega
    
    -- Establish relation between 2^n mod 7 and n mod 3
    have h_pow_mod_n : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by
      rw [← Nat.div_add_mod n 3]
      simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_comm]
      <;> norm_num
      <;> rfl

    -- Case analysis on n % 3
    have h_cases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
    rcases h_cases with (h_r | h_r | h_r)
    · -- Case n % 3 = 0
      apply Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero
      exact h_r
    · -- Case n % 3 = 1
      have h_calc : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 := by
        rw [h_pow_mod_n]
        rw [h_r]
        norm_num
      rw [h_calc] at h_val
      norm_num at h_val
      contradiction
    · -- Case n % 3 = 2
      have h_calc : 2 ^ n % 7 = 4 := by
        rw [h_pow_mod_n]
        rw [h_r]
        norm_num
      rw [h_calc] at h_val
      norm_num at h_val
      contradiction
  · -- Backward direction: 3 ∣ n → 7 ∣ 2^n - 1
    intro h
    have h_dvd : 3 ∣ n := h
    have h_mod : n % 3 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h_dvd
    have h_pow_mod_n : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by
      rw [← Nat.div_add_mod n 3]
      simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_comm]
      <;> norm_num
      <;> rfl
    have h_pow_mod : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by

      rw [h_mod]
      norm_num
    have h_ge : 1 ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    have h_sub_mod : (2 ^ n - 1) % 7 = 0 := by
      have h_sub : (2 ^ n - 1) % 7 = (2 ^ n % 7 - 1) % 7 := by
        rw [Nat.mod_sub_mod h_ge]
      rw [h_sub]
      rw [h_pow_mod]
      norm_num
    rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
    exact h_sub_mod

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n` modulo `7` depends only on `n mod 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := (Nat.mod_add_div n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3))) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this

open Nat

lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := (Nat.mod_add_div n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * (2 ^ (n % 3))) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this, one_mul]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa

import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModPow
import Mathlib.Tactic

open Nat

/-- Adding three to the exponent does not change `2 ^ n % 7`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven_add_three (n : ℕ) :
    (2 ^ (n + 3)) % 7 = (2 ^ n) % 7 := by
  have h23 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  calc
    (2 ^ (n + 3)) % 7
        = ((2 ^ n) * (2 ^ 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ n) % 7 * (2 ^ 3) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = ((2 ^ n) % 7 * 1) % 7 := by simpa [h23]
    _ = (2 ^ n) % 7 := by simpa

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num

  obtain ⟨q, r, hqr, hr_lt⟩ := Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod (by decide : 0 < 3) n
  -- `n = 3 * q + r`
  have hdiv : n = 3 * q + r := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.add_comm] using hqr
  -- compute the remainder modulo 7
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * q + r)) % 7 := by simpa [hdiv]
    _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ q * 2 ^ r) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ q % 7 * (2 ^ r) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ r) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ q) % 7 = 1 := by
            have : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
            simpa [this] using (Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) q 7)
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ r) % 7 := by simpa
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          have : r = n % 3 := by
            have : r < 3 := hr_lt
            have : r = n % 3 := by
              have := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr_lt
              simpa using this
            exact this
          simpa [this]

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  -- rewrite divisibility as a congruence
  have h₁ : (7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1) ↔ (2 ^ n ≡ 1 [MOD 7]) := by
    simpa using (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff (a := 2 ^ n) (b := 1) (n := 7)).symm
  -- reduce the exponent modulo 3
  have h₂ : (2 ^ n ≡ 1 [MOD 7]) ↔ (2 ^ (n % 3) ≡ 1 [MOD 7]) := by
    have h_eq := pow_mod_seven_eq n
    constructor
    · intro h
      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [Nat.ModEq] using h
      have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [h_eq] using this
      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using this
    · intro h
      have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [Nat.ModEq] using h
      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
        have h_eq := pow_mod_seven_eq n
        simpa [h_eq] using this
      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using this
  -- evaluate the three possible remainders
  have h₃ : (2 ^ (n % 3) ≡ 1 [MOD 7]) ↔ n % 3 = 0 := by
    have h0 : (2 ^ 0) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
    have h1 : (2 ^ 1) % 7 = 2 := by norm_num
    have h2 : (2 ^ 2) % 7 = 4 := by norm_num

    · -- case 1
      simp [Nat.ModEq, h1] at *
    · -- case 2
      simp [Nat.ModEq, h2] at *

    simpa [h₁, h₂] using h₃

  simpa [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] using h₄

/-- Helper lemma: 2^n mod 7 depends only on n mod 3 -/
lemma pow_two_mod_7 (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by
  have h_decomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by rw [Nat.div_add_mod]
  rw [h_decomp]
  rw [pow_add]
  rw [pow_mul]
  -- Calculate ((2^3)^(n/3)) % 7
  have h_base : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have h_pow_base : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.pow_mod (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7]
    rw [h_base]
    simp [Nat.pow_mod, Nat.one_pow]
    <;> norm_num
  -- Combine
  calc
    2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3) % 7 = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by simp [Nat.mul_mod]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by rw [h_pow_base]
    _ = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by simp [Nat.mul_one_mod]

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  constructor
  · -- Forward direction: 7 ∣ 2^n - 1 → 3 ∣ n
    intro h
    have h_mod : (2 ^ n - 1) % 7 = 0 := Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mp h
    have h_ge : 1 ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.one_le_pow (by decide) hn
    have h_pow_mod : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      have h_eq : 2 ^ n = (2 ^ n - 1) + 1 := by rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel h_ge]
      rw [h_eq]
      simp [Nat.add_mod, h_mod]
    have h_val : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := pow_two_mod_7 n
    rw [h_val] at h_pow_mod
    have h_cases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
    rcases h_cases with (h_val | h_val | h_val)
    · -- Case n % 3 = 0
      rw [h_val] at h_pow_mod
      norm_num at h_pow_mod
      rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
      exact h_val
    · -- Case n % 3 = 1
      rw [h_val] at h_pow_mod
      norm_num at h_pow_mod
      contradiction
    · -- Case n % 3 = 2
      rw [h_val] at h_pow_mod
      norm_num at h_pow_mod
      contradiction
  · -- Backward direction: 3 ∣ n → 7 ∣ 2^n - 1
    intro h
    have h_dvd : 3 ∣ n := h
    have h_mod_n : n % 3 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h_dvd
    have h_val : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := pow_two_mod_7 n
    rw [h_val]
    rw [h_mod_n]
    norm_num

    have h_mod_2n : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      rw [h_val]
      rw [h_mod_n]
      norm_num
    have h_sub_mod : (2 ^ n - 1) % 7 = 0 := by
      rw [Nat.mod_sub_mod h_ge]
      simp [h_mod_2n]
      norm_num
    rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]

import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModPow
import Mathlib.Tactic

open Nat

lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.add_comm] using (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := h3
            simpa [this] using (Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7)
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  -- rewrite divisibility as a congruence
  have hmod : (7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1) ↔ (2 ^ n ≡ 1 [MOD 7]) := by
    simpa [Nat.ModEq, Nat.sub_eq, Nat.add_comm] using
      (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff (a := 2 ^ n) (b := 1) (n := 7)).symm
  -- reduce the exponent modulo 3
  have hpow : (2 ^ n ≡ 1 [MOD 7]) ↔ n % 3 = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h1 : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [Nat.ModEq] using h
      have h2 : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n] using h1
      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k =>
        have hk_lt : k < 2 := by
          have : Nat.succ k < 3 := by
            simpa using hlt
          exact Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp this
        interval_cases k using hk_lt with
        | zero =>
          -- n % 3 = 1, contradiction
          have : (2 ^ 1) % 7 = 1 := by
            simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using h2
          norm_num at this
        | succ k' =>
          -- k' = 0, so n % 3 = 2, contradiction
          have : (2 ^ 2) % 7 = 1 := by
            have : (2 ^ (Nat.succ (Nat.succ 0))) % 7 = 1 := by
              simpa using h2
            simpa using this
          norm_num at this
    · intro hzero
      have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [hzero] using (by norm_num : (2 ^ 0) % 7 = 1)
      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n] using this
      dsimp [Nat.ModEq]
      simpa [this]
  have : (7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1) ↔ n % 3 = 0 := hmod.trans hpow
  simpa [Nat.mod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] using this

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (b): no positive `n` has `7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1`. -/
theorem p09_b (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := by

          exact this (by simpa using hmod')
      | succ k' =>

          have : ((2 ^ (Nat.succ (Nat.succ 0))) % 7 + 1) % 7 ≠ 0 := by

open Nat

lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.add_comm] using (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := h3
            simpa [this] using (Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7)
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

  -- reduce the exponent modulo 3
  have hpow : (2 ^ n ≡ 1 [MOD 7]) ↔ n % 3 = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h1 : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [Nat.ModEq] using h
      have h2 : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n] using h1
      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k =>
        have hk_lt : k < 2 := by
          have : Nat.succ k < 3 := by

          exact Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp this
        interval_cases k using hk_lt with

/-- Helper lemma: 2^n mod 7 depends only on n mod 3 -/

  have h_decomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by rw [Nat.div_add_mod]
  rw [h_decomp]
  rw [pow_add]
  rw [pow_mul]
  -- Calculate ((2^3)^(n/3)) % 7

    rw [Nat.pow_mod]
    rw [h_base]
    simp [Nat.one_pow]
    <;> norm_num

    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by simp [Nat.mul_mod]

  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self] using (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * (2 ^ (n % 3))) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) * (2 ^ (n % 3))) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (( (2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) % 7) * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = ((1) * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := h3
            simpa [this] using (Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7)
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

    simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self] using (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm

    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (( (2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) % 7) * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]

            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]

lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num

        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]

          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by

    _ = (( (2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) % 7) * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by

/-- Helper lemma: 2^n mod 7 depends only on n mod 3 -/
lemma pow_two_mod_7 (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by
  have h_decomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by rw [Nat.div_add_mod]
  rw [h_decomp]
  rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
  -- 2^(3k+r) = (2^3)^k * 2^r
  -- (2^3)^k % 7 = 8^k % 7 = 1^k % 7 = 1
  have h_base : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have h_pow_base : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.mod_add_div ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) 7]
    simp [h_base, Nat.pow_mod]
    <;> norm_num
    <;> rfl
  calc
    2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3) % 7 = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by simp [Nat.mul_mod]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by rw [h_pow_base]
    _ = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by simp [Nat.mul_one, Nat.mod_mod]

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    have := Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3
    -- `this` is `n % 3 + 3 * (n / 3) = n`
    simpa [add_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using this.symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (( (2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) % 7) * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = ((1) * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

    simp [h_base]

  rw [Nat.mul_mod]
  rw [h_pow_base]
  simp [Nat.mul_one, Nat.mod_mod]

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/

        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (( (2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) % 7) * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by

    _ = ((1) * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by

    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

    have := Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3
    -- this : n % 3 + 3 * (n / 3) = n
    simpa [add_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using this.symm

        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by

    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by

import Mathlib
import Mathlib.Tactic.IntervalCases

open Nat

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    have := Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3
    -- `this` : n % 3 + 3 * (n / 3) = n
    simpa [add_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using this.symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (( (2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) % 7) * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = ((1) * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  constructor
  · intro h7
    -- turn divisibility into a congruence
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      have : (2 ^ n) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mpr h7
      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using this
    -- reduce the exponent modulo 3
    have hrem : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
      simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n] using hmod
    -- analyse the possible remainders of `n` modulo 3
    have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt

        simpa [h1] using hrem
      have : (2 : ℕ) = 1 := by

      exact (False.elim (by decide : False))
    · have : (2 ^ 2) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [h2] using hrem
      have : (4 : ℕ) = 1 := by
        simpa using this
      exact (False.elim (by decide : False))
  · intro h3
    have hmod3 : n % 3 = 0 := (Nat.mod_eq_zero_iff_dvd).mpr h3
    have hrem : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      have := pow_mod_seven_eq n
      simpa [hmod3] using this
    have : (2 ^ n) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by
      dsimp [Nat.ModEq]
      simpa [hrem]
    exact (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mpr this

import Mathlib
import Mathlib.Tactic.IntervalCases

open Nat

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    have := Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3
    -- this : n % 3 + 3 * (n / 3) = n
    simpa [add_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using this.symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3)) ) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (( (2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) % 7) * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            -- ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = ((2 ^ 3) % 7) ^ (n / 3) % 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  constructor
  · intro h7
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mpr h7
    have hrem : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa using (show (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 from by
          -- from hmod
          simpa using hmod)
      simpa [pow_mod_seven_eq n] using this
    have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
    · exact (Nat.mod_eq_zero_iff_dvd).mp h0
    · have : (2 ^ 1) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [h1] using hrem
      norm_num at this
    · have : (2 ^ 2) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [h2] using hrem
      norm_num at this
  · intro h3
    have hmod3 : n % 3 = 0 := (Nat.mod_eq_zero_iff_dvd).mpr h3
    have hrem : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      have := pow_mod_seven_eq n
      simpa [hmod3] using this
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
      dsimp [Nat.ModEq]
      simpa [hrem]
    exact (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mpr hmod

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (b): no positive `n` has `7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1`. -/
theorem p09_b (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬ 7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := by
  intro h7
  have hmod : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 0 := (Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero).mp h7

    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    have := Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3
    -- this : n % 3 + 3 * (n / 3) = n
    simpa [add_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using this.symm

      simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
      simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven_eq (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num

    simpa [add_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
      (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm

      simpa [hdecomp]

      simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]

      simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by

  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    simpa [add_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
      (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
      simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
      simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
      simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
      simpa [pow_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
      have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
        have := (Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7)
        simpa [h3] using this
      simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

          simpa [hdecomp]

          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by

import Mathlib
import Mathlib.Tactic.IntervalCases
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq

open Nat

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    simpa [add_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
      (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  constructor
  · intro h7
    -- from divisibility we get a congruence modulo 7
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff).mpr h7
    have hmod1 : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hmod
    have hrem : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
      simpa [pow_mod_seven n] using hmod1
    have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
    · exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h0
    · have : False := by
        have h : (2 ^ 1) % 7 = 1 := by simpa [h1] using hrem
        norm_num at h
      exact (False.elim this)
    · have : False := by
        have h : (2 ^ 2) % 7 = 1 := by simpa [h2] using hrem
        norm_num at h
      exact (False.elim this)
  · intro h3
    have h0 : n % 3 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h3
    have hmod1 : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      calc
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (b): no positive `n` has `7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1`. -/

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    simpa [add_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
      (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    simpa [add_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
      (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by

import Mathlib
import Mathlib.Tactic.IntervalCases
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq

open Nat

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    simpa [add_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
      (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by

      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)

    · exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h0
    · have : False := by

    · have : False := by

    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using

        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]

          simpa [pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by

            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using
      (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModPow

open Nat

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using
      (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

  constructor
  · intro h7

      (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff (by decide : (7 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).mpr h7

      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hmod
    have hrem : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
      simpa [pow_mod_seven n] using hmod1
    have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt

    · have : False := by
        have : (2 ^ 1) % 7 = 1 := by
          simpa [h1] using hrem
        norm_num at this
      exact this.elim
    · have : False := by
        have : (2 ^ 2) % 7 = 1 := by
          simpa [h2] using hrem
        norm_num at this
      exact this.elim
  · intro h3
    have h0 : n % 3 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h3
    have hmod1 : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      calc

          simpa [pow_mod_seven n]
        _ = (2 ^ 0) % 7 := by simpa [h0]

    · have : (2 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by

    · have : (3 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by

    · have : (4 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by

      norm_num at this
    · have : (5 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/

    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using
      (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm

    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 % 7 := by
        simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hmod

    -- analyse the possible remainders of `n % 3`

      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt

    · exfalso
      have : (2 ^ 1) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [h1] using hrem
      have : (2 ^ 1) % 7 ≠ 1 := by norm_num
      exact this ‹_›
    · exfalso
      have : (2 ^ 2) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [h2] using hrem
      have : (2 ^ 2) % 7 ≠ 1 := by norm_num
      exact this ‹_›
  · intro h3
    have h0 : n % 3 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h3

  rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
  -- (2^3)^(n/3) * 2^(n%3)
  have h_base : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have h_pow_base : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
    rw [Nat.pow_mod]
    simp [h_base, Nat.one_pow]
    <;> norm_num
  have h_mul_mod : (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 
    (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by simp [Nat.mul_mod]
  rw [h_mul_mod]
  rw [h_pow_base]
  simp [Nat.mul_one, Nat.mod_mod]

import Mathlib

/-- Helper lemma: 2^n mod 7 depends only on n mod 3 -/
lemma pow_two_mod_7 (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ n % 7 = 2 ^ (n % 3) % 7 := by
  have h_decomp : n = (n / 3) * 3 + n % 3 := by rw [Nat.div_add_mod]
  rw [h_decomp]
  rw [pow_add]
  rw [← Nat.mul_comm]
  rw [pow_mul]
  -- (2^3)^(n/3) * 2^(n%3)
  have h_base : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have h_pow_base : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
    rw [Nat.pow_mod]
    simp [h_base, Nat.one_pow]
    <;> norm_num
  have h_mul_mod : (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 
    (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7)) % 7 := by simp [Nat.mul_mod]
  rw [h_mul_mod]
  rw [h_pow_base]
  simp [Nat.mul_one, Nat.mod_mod]

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  constructor
  · -- Forward direction: 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 → 3 ∣ n
    intro h_dvd
    have h_mod : (2 ^ n - 1) % 7 = 0 := Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mp h_dvd
    have h_ge : 1 ≤ 2 ^ n := by apply Nat.one_le_pow; decide
    have h_add : (2 ^ n - 1) + 1 = 2 ^ n := Nat.sub_add_cancel h_ge
    have h_val : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      rw [← h_add]
      simp [Nat.add_mod, h_mod]
      <;> norm_num
    
    rw [pow_two_mod_7] at h_val
    have h_cases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
    rcases h_cases with (h | h | h)
    · -- Case n % 3 = 0
      rw [h] at h_val
      norm_num at h_val
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h
    · -- Case n % 3 = 1
      rw [h] at h_val
      norm_num at h_val
      omega
    · -- Case n % 3 = 2
      rw [h] at h_val
      norm_num at h_val
      omega
  · -- Backward direction: 3 ∣ n → 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1
    intro h_dvd
    have h_mod : n % 3 = 0 := Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mp h_dvd
    have h_val : 2 ^ n % 7 = 1 := by
      rw [pow_two_mod_7]
      rw [h_mod]
      norm_num
    have h_ge : 1 ≤ 2 ^ n := by apply Nat.one_le_pow; decide
    have h_div : 2 ^ n = 7 * (2 ^ n / 7) + 1 := by
      rw [← Nat.mod_add_div (2 ^ n) 7]
      rw [h_val]
      simp [add_comm]
    have h_sub : 2 ^ n - 1 = 7 * (2 ^ n / 7) := by
      rw [h_div]
      omega
    have h_sub_mod : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 := by
      rw [h_sub]
      exact ⟨2 ^ n / 7, by ring⟩
    exact h_sub_mod

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (b): no positive `n` has `7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1`. -/
theorem p09_b (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := by
  intro h_dvd
  have h_mod : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 0 := Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mp h_dvd
  have h_val : 2 ^ n % 7 = 6 := by
    have h_sum : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = (2 ^ n % 7 + 1 % 7) % 7 := by simp [Nat.add_mod]
    rw [h_sum] at h_mod
    omega
  
  rw [pow_two_mod_7] at h_val
  have h_cases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
  rcases h_cases with (h | h | h)
  · -- Case n % 3 = 0
    rw [h] at h_val
    norm_num at h_val
    omega
  · -- Case n % 3 = 1
    rw [h] at h_val
    norm_num at h_val
    omega
  · -- Case n % 3 = 2
    rw [h] at h_val
    norm_num at h_val
    omega

import Mathlib
import Mathlib.Tactic.IntervalCases
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModPow

open Nat

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using
      (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  constructor
  · intro h7
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] :=
      (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff (by decide : (7 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).mpr h7
    have hrem : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 % 7 := by
        simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hmod
      simpa [pow_mod_seven n] using this
    have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
    · exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h0
    · have : (2 ^ 1) % 7 ≠ 1 := by norm_num
      exact (this (by simpa [h1] using hrem)).elim
    · have : (2 ^ 2) % 7 ≠ 1 := by norm_num
      exact (this (by simpa [h2] using hrem)).elim
  · intro h3
    have h0 : n % 3 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h3
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      calc
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mod_seven n]
        _ = (2 ^ 0) % 7 := by simpa [h0]
        _ = 1 := by norm_num
    have hmod_eq : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
      dsimp [Nat.ModEq]
      simpa using hmod
    exact (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff (by decide : (7 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).mp hmod_eq

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (b): no positive `n` has `7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1`. -/

          simpa [hdecomp]

            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7

  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using
      (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModPow

open Nat

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using
      (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  have h7ne : (7 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by decide
  constructor
  · intro hdiv
    -- turn divisibility into a congruence
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff h7ne).mp hdiv
    have hmod' : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hmod
    have hrem : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
      simpa [pow_mod_seven n] using hmod'
    -- analyse the possible remainders of `n` modulo 3
    have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
    · exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h0
    · have hneq : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 ≠ 1 := by
        have : (2 ^ 1) % 7 ≠ 1 := by norm_num
        simpa [h1] using this
      exact (hneq hrem).elim
    · have hneq : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 ≠ 1 := by
        have : (2 ^ 2) % 7 ≠ 1 := by norm_num
        simpa [h2] using this
      exact (hneq hrem).elim
  · intro h3
    have h0 : n % 3 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h3
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      calc
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mod_seven n]
        _ = (2 ^ 0) % 7 := by simpa [h0]
        _ = 1 := by norm_num
    have hmod_eq : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
      dsimp [Nat.ModEq]
      simpa using hmod
    exact (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff h7ne).mpr hmod_eq
      

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (b): no positive `n` has `7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1`. -/
theorem p09_b (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬ 7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := by
  intro hdiv
  have hzero : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 0 := (Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero).mp hdiv
  have hcalc : ((2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by
    have : ((2 ^ n) % 7 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by
      simpa [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by decide : (1 : ℕ) < 7)] using hzero
    simpa [pow_mod_seven n] using this
  have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
    have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
    interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt
  rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
  · have : ((2 ^ 0) % 7 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by
      simpa [h0] using hcalc
    have : ((2 ^ 0) % 7 + 1) % 7 ≠ 0 := by norm_num
    exact this.elim
  · have : ((2 ^ 1) % 7 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by
      simpa [h1] using hcalc
    have : ((2 ^ 1) % 7 + 1) % 7 ≠ 0 := by norm_num
    exact this.elim
  · have : ((2 ^ 2) % 7 + 1) % 7 = 0 := by
      simpa [h2] using hcalc
    have : ((2 ^ 2) % 7 + 1) % 7 ≠ 0 := by norm_num
    exact this.elim

    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using
      (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm

    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]

          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

import Mathlib.Tactic.IntervalCases
import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModPow

open Nat

/-- For any `n`, `2 ^ n % 7` depends only on `n % 3`. -/
lemma pow_mod_seven (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
  have h3 : (2 ^ 3) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using
      (Nat.mod_mul_left_div_self n 3).symm
  calc
    (2 ^ n) % 7
        = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [hdecomp]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_add, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = ((2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_mul_right_mod]
    _ = (((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 * (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7) % 7 := by
          have : ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
            have := Nat.mod_pow (2 ^ 3) (n / 3) 7
            simpa [h3] using this
          simpa [this]
    _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by simp

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  have h7ne : (7 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by decide
  constructor
  · intro hdiv
    -- turn divisibility into a congruence
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff h7ne).mpr hdiv
    have hmod' : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hmod
    have hrem : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by
      simpa [pow_mod_seven n] using hmod'
    -- analyse the possible remainders of `n` modulo 3
    have hcases : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
    · exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h0
    · have hneq : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 ≠ 1 := by
        have : (2 ^ 1) % 7 ≠ 1 := by norm_num
        simpa [h1] using this
      exact (hneq hrem).elim
    · have hneq : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 ≠ 1 := by
        have : (2 ^ 2) % 7 ≠ 1 := by norm_num
        simpa [h2] using this
      exact (hneq hrem).elim
  · intro h3
    have h0 : n % 3 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h3
    have hmod : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      calc
        (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
          simpa [pow_mod_seven n]
        _ = (2 ^ 0) % 7 := by simpa [h0]
        _ = 1 := by norm_num
    have hmod_eq : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
      dsimp [Nat.ModEq]
      simpa using hmod
    exact (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff h7ne).mpr hmod_eq
